verdict.rationale: Beamer's documented feedback capture is in-app only: comments and reactions on its own changelog posts, plus NPS surveys. Nothing shows it automatically pulling feedback out of sales calls, support tickets, or chat conversations. The support-app integration is described as closing the feedback loop, not ingesting feedback from those sources, and the HubSpot sync is an adjacent integration with no stated feedback-extraction role.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can automatically capture customer feedback mentioned in sales calls, support tickets, and chat conversations
